personas.ai_literacy_level: Medium: Basic understanding of generative AI tools and some familiarity with common indicators of AI-generated content. Can occasionally identify synthetic patterns but may miss subtle cues.
personas.prior_ai_use: Occasional: Uses AI tools periodically for tasks such as writing assistance, brainstorming, image generation, or information gathering.
personas.online_content_skepticism: High: Frequently evaluates online content critically and actively looks for signs of manipulation, misinformation, or synthetic generation.
personas.attention_to_detail: Medium: Pays attention to noticeable details but may not consistently inspect all aspects of the content carefully.
personas.prior_exposure_to_misinformation: Medium: Some prior exposure to misinformation, fake news, or online discussions about deceptive content.
